en.title: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran
en.edition: Wording follows the first edition (New York: Alfred A. Knopf; London: George Allen & Unwin, 1930). Digital base text: Tanzil 'en.pickthall' (an edited electronic text of unidentified origin, descended from the USC-MSA text), mirrored in fawazahmed0/quran-api edition 'eng-mohammedmarmadu', corrected to the 1930 wording
en.license: The 1930 translation is in the public domain: the translator died in 1936, so the term has ended in life+70 countries (Australia, the UK, the EU) and in Bangladesh (life+60), and the 1930 US publication entered the US public domain on 1 January 2026. Tanzil offers its translation files for non-commercial use with credit (tanzil.net/trans); this app is free and non-commercial and credits Tanzil. The fawazahmed0/quran-api repository is released under The Unlicense. The wording of later revised printings is not used.
en.attribution: English translation: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930 first edition). Digital base text from Tanzil (tanzil.net) via fawazahmed0/quran-api, corrected to the 1930 wording.
notices: Wording follows the 1930 first edition. 393 verses of the Tanzil text are corrected to the 1930 wording (transcription errors, the replaced words "God", "Owner" and "Mecca", and the edited electronic text's rewordings), each checked against three 1930 copies and later printings. Modern spellings (judgment, steadfast and similar) and the digital text's punctuation are kept. Every change, with the replaced text, the reason and the checks made, is listed in data/quran/en-corrections.json and docs/translation-audit.md.
